newsitem.title: USA: Summit Bancorp to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Summit Bancorp to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Summit Bancorp said on Thursday it would call for redemption of all outstanding shares of its Series B and C adjustable-rate cumulative preferred stock on December 15.
The redemption is subject to Federal Reserve Board approval, the bank said.
Each Series B share would be redeemed at $50.375, or the $50 stated value, plus accrued dividends of $0.375 through the redemption date at the current annual rate of 6.0 percent.
Each Series C share would be redeemed at $25.375, or the $25 stated value and accrued dividends of $0.375 through the redemption date at the current annual rate of 6.0 percent.
